title: Strongest on Record

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going: Washington denies Iran talks as the Guard turns offensive, a drone strike kills 153 at an Abyei market, and the UN warns of a record El Nino. Small lifts: Ukraine peace talks resume, Pope Leo recovers, Perseverance drives farther than any rover.

style.genre: drone post-rock — vibraphone, choir, fretless bass, CR-78

lines: No talks, the White House says,
the Guard turns its doctrine round,
and in Abyei the market stalls
east Spain shovels out the mud,
the border speakers hum back on.
Still a rover rolls the farthest
three chairs pulled back to one table,
and an old man walking on.
